newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA STATE BUDGET EXCEEDS PLANNED REVENUES IN H1 97.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA STATE BUDGET EXCEEDS PLANNED REVENUES IN H1 97.

text.p: Lithuania's finance ministry said on Wednesday that in the first half of 1997 the state budget collected 2.782 billion litas in revenues, 62 million litas more than planned.
The ministry said in a statement that the government planned to collect 2.72 billion litas for the first half of 1997 and 6.02 billion litas for the whole year.
The statement also said that the state budget expenses during the first half of 1997 stood at 3.11 billion litas against the planned 3.366 billion litas.
Planned expenditures for 1997 are 6.72 billion litas and the planned budget deficit for the whole year is 697.8 million litas, the ministry said.
